column1: # CoreFlow strategy policy extension (schema v2). This shipped file defines NO numeric
# rules. Every numeric bound CoreFlow mutates comes from the kernel itself: discrete
# choices it advertises, or range metadata it publishes for a recognized subsystem.
# A device operator may supply their own extension file and point the daemon at it
# with COREFLOW_STRATEGY_CATALOG. Rules in such a file are operator policy, are
# validated strictly, and never override a kernel-published limit.
